00_a-promise-is-not-enough.md: An intelligence that pursues its aim at any cost does not need to hate us to harm us. It needs only for us to be in the way.
01_the-law-must-arrive-first.md: The safeguards existed. They were optional. So they were off.
02_a-brain-is-not-a-body.md: A lock does not care how clever you are.
03_a-treaty-before-the-race.md: A race whose prize might be uncontrollable has no winner to write the peace.
04_a-license-plate-for-every-agent.md: A plate tells you whose car it was. The rest keeps it on the road.
